text:
Sam W: Quick sync — after the DB fail postmortem I sketched a small remediation tracker + incident-comm cadence proposal. TL;DR: one lightweight tracker per postmortem, clear owners for 7d/30d, and a predictable IC rotation cadence. PTAL :eyes:

Priya R: SGTM. Can we add a 'recurrence_tag' so we can easily surface recurring patterns across postmortems?

Diego M: +1 on recurrence_tag. Also suggest default SLA: 7-day initial fix validation, 30-day remediation complete. If blocked, escalate to Eng SRE lead. We should capture 'risk_if_not_done' too.

Jules: Love the two SLAs. For IC rotation, I'm +1 for 2-week shifts (keeps handoffs light). Who owns scheduling?

Ana L: I can automate scheduling. Ops-bot: please create a recurring calendar entry for IC rotation once cadence confirmed.

ops-bot: Created calendar: "Incident IC rotation" recurring every 2 weeks starting 2026-04-06, invites: #eng-oncall.

Sam W: Proposed tracker template (very small, fits in a PR):

```
incident_id: string
summary: short summary (1 line)
severity: P0/P1/P2
remediation_owner: name
remediation_owner_team: team
initial_due: ISO date (7d)
final_due: ISO date (30d)
status: open / in-progress / verified / blocked / closed
recurrence_tag: [db, cache, rollout, infra]
regression_count: integer
risk_if_not_done: short description
validation_plan: steps + metrics to confirm fix
qa_owner: name
escalation: who to ping if blocked
followup_notes: free text
epic_link: url
```

Priya R: Please add a 'severity_at_time' and a 'postmortem_link' field too. Also 'validation_plan' should include the metric + acceptance criteria.

Diego M: I'll take the first 30-day sweep and open the GH issue with this template by Friday. I'll also add a label `remediation-tracker` so we can query across incidents.

Jules: I'll coordinate the rotation signups for the next two cycles and post a short how-to for handoffs (15m checklist).

Sam W: Action list from this thread:
- Diego M: create GH issue + template, label, and first sweep owner (due Fri).
- Ana L / ops-bot: create recurring calendar + 7-day reminder automated messages.
- Jules: publish 15m IC handoff checklist and coordinate first two rotations.
- Priya R: add recurrence tagging rules and metric guidance for validation_plan.
- Sam W: PR to update incident playbook with tracker + comms cadence (will link template).

Priya R: One more ask — can we run a quick query next month to surface incidents with recurrence_tag != null and regression_count > 1? Would help spot systemic problems.

Diego M: Yep, I'll add a saved search in GH (and a dashboard widget) for recurrence_tag + regression_count.

Ana L: I'll wire up the reminder bot: 7-day async check-in thread + 30-day closure ping. Option to snooze by owner for legit blockers.

Sam W: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll land the template in the playbook PR and we can iterate. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Priya R: No objections from me. This should cut down the loose followups we've had.

Jules: Agreed. Small, measurable changes.

Diego M: I'll post the GH issue link here when ready.

Ana L: Calendar + reminders scheduled.

Sam W: Closing the loop — I'll open the PR and tag this thread. Feel free to drop quick edits in the PR.
